stem: A 7-week-old infant is reviewed for a vascular skin lesion. Which diagnosis is the most common benign soft tissue tumour of childhood?
explanation: Infantile haemangioma is the most common benign soft tissue tumour of childhood.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 86

optionExplanations.A: Correct because infantile haemangioma is the most common benign soft tissue tumour of childhood.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a café au lait spot is a pigmented birthmark, not a soft tissue tumour.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because naevus flammeus is a capillary malformation, not a benign soft tissue tumour.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because an ash leaf macule is a hypopigmented skin lesion associated with tuberous sclerosis.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because an epidermal naevus is a developmental skin lesion, not the most common benign soft tissue tumour of childhood.
